title: Auspice v3.1.0: Interactive Visualisation of Phylogenomic data (Nextstrain)

provenance.origin: github.com/nextstrain/auspice at c3122c404328, github-search (phylogenetics visualization web app)

notes: Found in a public repository and run by a computer-use agent (batch public-1). Showing a pathogen's dated phylogeny next to a map of where samples came from, so a scientist can colour, filter, animate and zoom the tree to read how lineages diverged and spread between places. Data used in the run: example. tree.json is the workflow the agent did and a second agent replayed; run.json says how.
